decisions.inventory: 1,317 completed collector cards across eleven intact families: Base 330; Gold 330; Uncirculated Silver 330; Uncirculated Metallic Gold 165; Future Fiber Bats 33; Futures Game Jerseys 46; Signs of the Future 40; Red Ink 40; dual autograph 1; signed base relic 1; dual ROY relic 1. Exclude the two generic redemption tickets. Include the ROY singleton listed inline in the related-set index.
decisions.scope: Regular paper 2003 Bowman only. Exclude separate Chrome, Draft Picks & Prospects, Heritage and Best products. The preliminary box-back roster names Andres Torres, but the three actual regular Bowman autograph rosters do not; his released SOF-AT is in the separate Draft product. Do not manufacture a 41st regular Bowman autograph.
decisions.rookies: Exactly 165 true base RCs corroborated by the complete base labels, separate two-page rookie index and independent BCP flags. Check every rookie number, identity and team. Ten blue-subset prospects have earlier RCs; subset marketing and award names do not confer rookie status. No added RC suffixes on parallels, signatures or relics.
decisions.aliases: Verify six printed-name identities through original scans, primary TCDB person IDs and independent BCP names: #171 Ramon A. Martinez is Ramon Nivar; #190 Eny Cabreja is Wandy Rodriguez; #217 Jairo Garcia is Santiago Casilla; #258 Aneudis Mateo is Willy Corporan; #293 Carlos Rijo is Rafael Diaz; #317 Denny Tussen is Carlos Morla. Preserve each printed alias in variant while displaying the verified identity. Harmonize common Ichiro, Rob/Robby Hammock, Wil/Wilfredo Ledezma and CC/C.C. Sabathia spelling variants.
decisions.numbering: Preserve original catalogue card numbers across all complete checklists. The original Reyes back confirms FGAB-JR, correcting BCP FCAB-JR. The Metallic Gold partial parallel is exactly #166-330; do not extend it to Quincy Carter #157 or the veterans.
decisions.teams: Audit every independent supplementary tuple and complete parallel identity/team against base. Retain historical affiliations printed on relics. Original backs confirm Seung Song with Boston and Ricardo Rodriguez with Los Angeles. Victor Diaz FG-VD actually prints Cleveland Indians; retain that printed affiliation with an explicit historical-club discrepancy note.
decisions.serials: Uncirculated Silver is serial numbered /250. Metallic Gold has a stated 230-copy print run and is not serial numbered. Ordinary Gold uses thick cardstock and a gold-foil facsimile signature, not a certified autograph. No serial limits are invented for the autograph families or generic redemption tickets.
decisions.materials: Future Fiber contains game-used bats; Futures Game Jerseys contain game-worn jerseys from the 2002 event. Jose Reyes FGAB-JR contains a game-used base and certified autograph. ROY-JH contains Jennings jersey and Hinske bat. Selected original fronts/backs establish the material, subject order and code corrections.
decisions.packConfiguration: Hobby draft: 24 packs x 10 nominal cards, corroborated by BCP and BBCE. DA Card World and Waxstat report nine; preserve that conflict for wrapper QA. HTA uses 12 packs x 21 cards. Gold is one per pack. Silver box toppers and Metallic Gold mail-in fulfilment are not ordinary pack hit pools.
decisions.packOdds: Verified Hobby denominators 1, 26, 687, 9220 and 765 belong on ProductSets. Keep the 33-card bat and 40-card plain-autograph checklists intact; no verified unified integer aggregate replaces their tier rates, so odds remain null pending QA. HTA-only Reyes and nonpack encased families also have null Hobby odds. Preserve all original groups/formats in source evidence. No pack-engine change or invented rounded probability.
decisions.verificationLimit: Catalogue-level audit of every output number, subject, team, subset and RC, with full independent rosters plus 24 original card images and two packaging images. This is not a visual audit of every physical card. Pricing, images, wrapper count, tier aggregates and box-topper/format collation remain pending release QA.
decisions.release: Unreleased Admin draft for pricing and image harvesting. No production database access, release or deployment. Importer dry-run is default; reruns preserve existing prices, images and release state.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete 330-card paper checklist: Veterans #1-155 and Rookies/Prospects #156-330, including 165 independently verified true RCs. Six printed-name identities retain their original names in metadata.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: Complete independently retrieved 330-card parallel, one per pack. Thick cardstock and gold-foil facsimile signature. No certified autograph or serial-number claim.

productSets.name: Uncirculated Silver
productSets.notes: 330 encased individual cards serial numbered /250, issued as Hobby/HTA box toppers. The catalogue count of 331 includes one generic complete-set exchange ticket, excluded from player inventory. Null pack odds.

productSets.name: Uncirculated Metallic Gold
productSets.notes: 165 fulfilled encased mail-in cards, exactly #166-330. Stated print run 230, not serial /230. The catalogue count of 166 includes a generic exchange ticket, excluded. Retail 1:49 was ticket odds; no ordinary player-card pack odds. Redemption expired April 30, 2004.

productSets.name: Future Fiber Bats
productSets.notes: Complete 33-card game-used bat family. Hobby groups 1:96 and 1:393; HTA groups 1:34 and 1:140; no retail. Keep the collector family intact and preserve the seven Group B subjects in source notes. No verified unified integer rate: null pending QA.

productSets.name: Futures Game Jerseys
productSets.notes: Complete 46-card game-worn jersey family from the 2002 Futures Game. Hobby 1:26, Retail 1:52, HTA 1:9. Retain printed historical affiliations; explicitly annotate Victor Diaz Cleveland back discrepancy.

productSets.name: Signs of the Future
productSets.notes: Complete 40-card signature family. Hobby tiers 1:39/183/2288 and HTA tiers 1:13/65/816 remain in source details. No verified aggregate: null pending QA. Preliminary Andres Torres box mention is not a 41st regular Bowman subject; his released card is in the separate Draft product.

productSets.name: Signs of the Future Red Ink
productSets.notes: Complete independently retrieved 40-card red-ink signature parallel. Hobby 1:687, HTA 1:245; no retail. Full number/name/team inventory compared with ordinary signatures. No new RC suffixes or invented serial limit.

productSets.name: Signs of the Future Dual
productSets.notes: DSF-CH certified dual autograph: Quincy Carter / Chad Hutchinson as Cubs/Cardinals baseball prospects. Hobby 1:9220, HTA 1:3264; no retail. Do not substitute their football team or infer new RC status.

productSets.name: Futures Game Base Autograph
productSets.notes: FGAB-JR Jose Reyes: certified autograph plus game-used BASE from the 2002 Futures Game, confirmed on original front/back. Correct BCP FCAB-JR typo. HTA exclusive 1:141, null Hobby odds; not a bat relic.

productSets.name: Dual Rookie of the Year Relic
productSets.notes: ROY-JH Jason Jennings / Eric Hinske: 2002 ROY tribute with Jennings game-worn jersey and Hinske game-used bat, Colorado/Toronto. Verified inline index, independent BCP and original front/back. Hobby 1:765, HTA 1:246; no retail or new RC suffixes.
